name: Unicorn
summary: A celestial horse that strikes with hooves and a radiant horn, heals and blesses allies, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The unicorn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

bonusActions.name: Unicorn's Blessing
bonusActions.text: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts *{ref:spell/cure-wounds}* or *{ref:spell/lesser-restoration}* on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the unicorn can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The unicorn regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Charging Horn
items.text: The unicorn moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

items.name: Shimmering Shield
items.text: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains {dmg:3d6} Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
